episode_title: Petra x Bernadetta C - Like Prey
source_summary: Bernadetta tries to ask Petra whether they can be friends; Petra sincerely says Bernadetta resembles prey, explains rabbit-like alertness, and accidentally terrifies her with bow safety talk.

characters.name: Petra
characters.identity_lock: Academy-era Petra: warm brown skin, long purple braid, face markings, white high-collar blouse with gold trim, black fitted waist bodice, black skirt, light shoulder strap; sincere and direct without caricature.

characters.name: Bernadetta
characters.identity_lock: Academy-era Bernadetta: short purple hair, small guarded posture, anxious but readable eyes, Black Eagles academy uniform; comic nervousness through posture and hesitation, not horror and not meme-faced.

frame_intents.start: Bernadetta backs away in full comic panic, still safe and unharmed.
frame_intents.key: Petra watches with a small confused frown, trying to understand the apology.
frame_intents.end: Petra answers sincerely while Bernadetta remains frozen mid-retreat.

dialogue.speaker: Bernadetta
dialogue.text: ベルが何をしたって言うのおおおおお！ 許してえええええええ！

dialogue.speaker: Petra
dialogue.text: 何も、していません。しかし、許す、構いません。

primary_check: Pay off Bernadetta's panic with Petra's literal, gentle misunderstanding.
